name: Spar
summary: A simple trick-taking game for 2-4 where only winning the final trick scores points.
rules_text: Use 36 cards A-K-Q-J-10-9-8-7-6 in four suits but remove Ace of Spades, leaving 35 cards. Deal 5 cards to each player: first 3 each, then 2 each. Player left of dealer leads first trick with any card face up. Others clockwise must follow suit if able, otherwise may play any card. Highest card of the led suit wins the trick and leads next trick, playing on top of pile. Play 5 tricks total. Only the winner of the fifth trick scores for the hand: 3 points if the winning card is a 6, 2 points if it is a 7, 1 point for any 8 or higher. Cards remain face up. Shuffle and deal next hand.
rating_reason: Trick-taking, last-trick goal, hidden hands, strategic
